about: A non-string argument is JSON as JSON.stringify writes it: shortest round-trip digits, an exponent below 1e-6 and from 1e21 (1e-7, 1e+21), -0 as 0; keys sorted by UTF-16 code units, so an emoji key comes before U+FF21 and '10' before '9'.
